notes.title: Version 0.3.8
notes.notes:
New Update for "Fishing Grind" 0.3.8

Hey everyone! Here is a small update for you all. I have been busy with life stuff, so the update is not very big. However, I am now on my retention arc and so updates might be more frequent. In all seriousness though, I did a lot of code reworking in this update to hopefully make development easier and bugs less common. Part two of the update is now in development and might come out within the next 8 months.



Patch Notes



New Content

Added Localization

Added a few new Tier 2 quests

Added Sunglasses

Added Bucket Hat

Added Emotes

Added Blood effects when the player shoots enemies

Added short intro cutscene to Market



Changes

Fixed a bug that locked up the player's control when being attacked by the Hunter

Fixed a bug that made it impossible to use fish traps

Overhaled save system

Lowered sonar range

Changed the "hide HUD" button to F8

Fixed a bug where the player could climb on some rocks and go out of bounds in Yellowstone

Removed volumetric clouds and replaced them with clouds that have better performance

Made it so players can move while using the quick menu



Localization

Added German and Russian languages



Emotes

Press the "1" and "2" keys to preform emotes.



Known Bugs

Can move in tutorial intro.

Fishing Rod invisible in tutorial intro.

Cougar sometimes instantly goes back and kills player after attacking.

Bear sometimes gets stuck while running.



If you find any bugs it would be really helpful if you reported them in our discord server or in community discussions!

notes.title: Version 0.3.7
notes.notes:
Small update to fix some bugs and add a little content!

@Fisherman New Update for "Fishing Grind" 0.3.7

Patch Notes

New Content

 Added four new clothing skins that can be unlocked in game
 You can now press the "F1" key to hide the HUD
 Added ability to collect mushrooms in Oregon
 Added a bunch of new missions


Changes

 Fixed weird light bugs in Yellowstone
 Fixed a bug that made it so the Hunter couldn't damage the player with his gun
 Lowered the price per pound for the cutthroat trout to $6 (was $12)
 Lowered the price per pound for the Suwannee bass to $12 (was $23)
 Lowered the price per pound for the Common Carp to $2 (was $3)

If you find any bugs it would be really helpful if you reported them in our discord server or in community discussions!

notes.title: Update 0.3.6
notes.notes:
News! I have started working on Localization! However, there is a large amount of text in the game, so it's going to be a while before it's actually added. The first two languages introduced will be Russian and German. Ice fishing is playable but there are still a lot of bugs and there is a lot of polish that will still be done. Working to roll out those updates soon!

New Update for "Fishing Grind" 0.3.6

Patch Notes

New Content

 Added North Dakota map
 Added New fish
 Added Ice Auger
 Added Ice Fishing
 Added Day/Night cycle
 Added enemy health scaling
 Added pelt quality mechanic
 Added ability to turn off dynamic resolution in settings
 Added new voice lines for Lenny when you get quests from him
 Added shotgun
 Added quest tiers
 Added PVP


Changes

 Improved performance on the Yellowstone and Oregon maps.
 Lowered medium fish trap price to $200
 Made deer AI slightly better by increasing the player detection radius
 Lowered bear health to 100 (was 200)
 Lowered cougar health to 80 (was 100)
 Made it so guns have limited range
 Added gun recoil animations and camera shake.
 Added quest description graphic when in Lenny's quest menu
 Made trap fish grabbing animation 25% faster


Enemy Health Scaling
Some enemies now have health scaling that depends on the number of players in the current match. This just means that when you have more people in a game, it will be harder to take down threats.

Pelt Quality
Animal hide/pelts now have a quality level. The more you shoot the animal, the more the quality goes down, which makes the value go down. Some guns tatter the pelts more then others.

Ice Fishing
In the new North Dakota map, you can drill holes in ice with the ice auger. If you stand near these ice holes and use your fishing rod you are able to ice fish. Ice fishing works similarly to regular fishing except the player

New Fish

 Walleye
 Northern Pike
 Suwannee Bass
 Cutthrout Trout
 Green Sunfish
 White Bass
 Yellow Perch
 Common Carp


Shotgun
Epic

PVP
There is a new toggle in the settings menu that lets you shoot your friends.

If you find any bugs it would be really helpful if you reported them in our discord server or in community discussions!

notes.title: Update 0.3.4
notes.notes:
Announcement
We are releasing a supporter pack! We don't feel like the game is in a state where we can justify actual DLCs, but we have had a few people express interest in supporting Fishing Grind financially. The pack comes with a clothing set, some items, and a prompt that lets you get your name in the credits if you are one of the first 100 to buy the pack! Sorry about the ice fishing delay, we have had some priority changes, but we plan to get it out as soon as possible! If you have any questions let us know in the comments of this post!

New Update for "Fishing Grind" 0.3.4

Patch Notes

New Content

 Added jumping
 Added sound effect when fish bites bobber
 Added English subtitles
 Added New quests
 Added sounds to the Market area


Changes

 Increased all Florida fish prices except for Alligator Gar
 Updated quest system
 Made many animation changes to make the player more dynamic
 Changed rarity of silver salmon to rare
 Changed rarity of bowfin to rare
 Made it so players can listen to Lookout tower tape multiple times


Bug Fixes
Fixed a bug that made the bobber splash particles flip out

Updated Quest System
You can now visit Lenny and trade quests in or out. You can carry up to four quests at a time. (If you have a save file from before this update then you may have up to seven quests equipped, this change won't effect you until you complete these quests or if you trade them out for other ones).

If you find any bugs it would be really helpful if you reported them in our discord server or in community discussions!

notes.title: Fishing Grind - The Yellowstone Update
notes.notes:
Announcement
Before you read the patch notes, I would like to get your attention for an important announcement. Our plans have changed, and we have decided to turn the ice fishing DLC into a FREE update! We realize the game still needs a lot of work. We want to keep improving it, but we are a small development team, and we all have our own busy lives, so it is going to take time. Thank you for all the support so far!

- LAGI Games

New Update for "Fishing Grind" 0.3.2

Patch Notes

New Content

 Added Yellowstone map
 Added informational signs to the Oregon map
 Added gun ammo
 Added several new fish types
 Added fish traps


Changes

 Added "volumetric clouds" toggle setting for performance
 Added 45 FPS option to Frame Rate dropdown
 Implemented many performance enhancements
 Improved gun aim down sights view
 Made it so bullet fires from iron sights instead of the middle of screen
 Implemented ability to drop unwanted fish
 Made it so host cannot go back to market unless all players have sold their fish
 Increased Live Crawfish uses from 3 to 5
 Lowered cost of Live Crawfish to $40
 Lowered effectivness of Live Crawfish by 85%
 Lowered Alligator health
 Made it so players can access the encyclopedia ingame
 Removed ability to access encyclopedia on the main menu
 Lowered cost of bear spray to $20
 Lowered cost of the Jointed Swimbait to $90
 Lowered cost of the Fakehopper to $35
 Made spinner bait more effective
 Removed film grain from Florida map
 Reworked the Handheld Sonar device
 Changed "Back to market" button UI to make it more visible
 Increased maximum bass size to 4lb
 Lowered bear pelt weight minimum and maximum
 Lowered alligator pelt weight minimum and maximum
 Changed salmon from silver to chinook
 Increased weight of Chinook salmon to 9lb
 Increased Chum Salmon price per pound to $2
 Lowered price of Florida map to $150
 Increased Chum Salmon price-per-pound to $3
 Decreased cost of backpack upgrade to $60
 Decreased cost of topwater frog to $20
 Made it so you can press the "Esc" key to close your takle box
 Increased bear's tolerance by 20%
 Added payouts to missions
 Increased cost of Alaska map to $45
 Lowered cost of PW700 to $30
 Lowered cost of Swibble caster to $65


Bug Fixes

 Fixed UI scaling on ultrawide monitors.
 Fixed a bug that made the bear freeze on some parts of the terrain
 Fixed a bug that made the player's bait dissapear in the tutorial sometimes


Known Issues

 Some player's computers crash when they finish the tutorial
 If host leaves lobby on main menu it can cause bugs later if the clients create their own lobbies


New Fish

 Brook Trout
 Smallmouth Bass
 Coho Salmon
 Red Drum


New Legendary Fish

 Lingcod - Alaska
 Flathead Catfish - Yellowstone


Yellowstone
Explore the stunning Wyoming landscape and catch the new Flathead Catfish!

Fish Traps
Two new fish traps have been added. You can place them almost anywhere near hotspots and over time they will passively trap fish, you can then claim the trapped fish and sell them at the truck.

Handheld Sonar Rework
In 0.3 handheld sonar worked by shooting a beam in the direction the player is looking, and if it detected any threats it would beep. We decided to experiment and change it to a device that beeps if it detects anything within a radius. You can also clip it to your belt so you can fish and use it at the same time.

If you find any bugs it would be really helpful if you reported them in our discord server or in community discussions!
